purpose: Teach: カンファレンス/コマーシャル/プロバイダー/申し入れ/立候補/過半数/申立/処遇

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、国際カンファレンスで発表しろ
lines.en: Ren. Present your work at the international conference.
lines.style: Calm, direct assignment. No preamble. Matter-of-fact authority wrapped in quiet confidence. The kind of instruction that doesn't ask permission.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費用にコマーシャル制作も入れたいです
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to include commercial production as part of the research budget.
lines.style: Hesitant step forward. Soft on the opening agreement, then gathering clarity as he explains. Careful not to overstep — checking Hiroshi's reaction through his own words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、プロバイダー選択でセキュリティ重視しろ
lines.en: When you choose a provider, prioritize security.
lines.style: Specific, practical. No drama. The voice of someone who has seen what carelessness costs. Brief pause before 'security' — the word lands with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共著者からの申し入れに丁寧に応えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll respond thoughtfully to any requests from my co-authors.
lines.style: Quick, obedient. But underneath — a small note of his own pride in doing this well. Not performing compliance; actually committing to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の役員に立候補してみろ
lines.en: Consider running for a position on the conference organizing committee.
lines.style: Encouraging, but still measured. Not a suggestion dressed as a command. A genuine opening, delivered in Hiroshi's even tone — trusting Ren to decide.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究で過半数の合意が必要です
lines.en: I understand. A joint project like that would need buy-in from over half the group.
lines.style: Thinking out loud. Quiet processing. Not resisting — analyzing the logistics in real time, almost to himself. The voice of someone already working through the problem.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文盗用の申立に備えて記録を残せ
lines.en: Keep detailed records in case there's a plagiarism claim.
lines.style: Steady, protective. No alarm in his voice — just foresight. The weight of experience without the weight of fear. Delivered as settled fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教官の処遇改善のため働きかけます
lines.en: Yes. I'll work on improving my advisor's situation and treatment.
lines.style: Firm commitment underneath careful words. A flash of genuine care — his advisor matters to him. Soft fade at the end, like he's already planning how to do this.
